command: echo '=== ARCHITECT FAILURE READONLY ==='; date -Is; hostname; echo '--- STATUS ---'; systemctl --user status frankenstein-architekt.service --no-pager -l || true; echo '--- TIMER ---'; systemctl --user list-timers --all --no-pager | grep -E 'frankenstein-architekt|NEXT|LEFT' || true; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-architekt.timer 2>/dev/null || true; echo '--- SCRIPT ---'; sed -n '1,260p' /home/andreas/architekt/lauf.sh 2>/dev/null || true; echo '--- ARCHITEKT DIR ---'; ls -lahrt /home/andreas/architekt 2>/dev/null | tail -n 40 || true; echo '=== END ==='; exit 0
